{{Version|2.2.23}}
<div style="display:flex">{{RandomChallengeCoinImage}}
<div style="margin: 0 5px;">Challenges are initially unlocked at Obelisk Level 10 and they are tasks that can be completed to earn Coins which then can be spent on permanent upgrades. There are currently three challenge tiers—'''Regular''', '''Extreme''', and '''Divine'''—each with its own currency and rewards table. The next challenge tier is unlocked by finishing '''<u>all</u>''' challenges from the previous tier.</div></div>
{{Clear|left}}

==Challenge Tiers==
<tabber class="sync sticky-header">Regular=
Regular Challenges are the first Challenges to be unlocked after defeating [[Obelisk|Obelisk]] level 10. Completing a Regular Challenge earns 10 {{Sprites|Challenge Coin||16}}.
